title: A named, described set of harvested sentences
description: A pool is a flat set of sentences with no cards in it. Keeping cards out is what lets one pool serve any inventory: a pool built against 200 surfaces would otherwise be useless at 2000. Every stage below a pool only ever narrows within it, so 'every example on this card came from one pool' holds by construction rather than by bookkeeping.

description.description: Free text: what this pool is for, in your own words. The field that makes a pool choosable months later.

intent.description: Optional: what you were trying to achieve, as opposed to what the config says.

variety.description: Optional tag such as european or brazilian. Advisory only; never used for selection.

config.description: The exact policy that produced this pool.

years.description: Release-year histogram, when the source carries it. Makes corpus recency inspectable without a separate lookup.
